# The glyph atlas

`ibm-vga-8x16.png` is 256 images, one per CP437 character, of the glyphs of **IBM VGA 8x16** by **VileR**
(The Ultimate Oldschool PC Font Pack v2.2, https://int10h.org/oldschool-pc-fonts/), licensed
**CC BY-SA 4.0**. It is 16 by 16 cells of 8 by 16 pixels in CP437 order, white on transparent.

It was rendered from the unmodified `WebPlus_IBM_VGA_8x16.woff` the ansiapps apps ship, by
`tools/render-vga-atlas.py` (outside the published package). VileR's readme says images rendered from the
fonts are not covered by ShareAlike. No font file, converted font or glyph table is part of Painter.
`VILER-README.txt` is the note the apps ship beside the font.
